entry.name: A real repository is created end to end on Forgejo
entry.expected: One real repository created through the shipped path on a live Forgejo instance, private, with origin wired AND reachable - `git ls-remote origin` in the new directory succeeds against the URL that was wired, which is the clause no earlier run settled.
entry.why_human: Out of reach, not merely unexercised: it needs a live forge account and an authenticated `tea`, plus an interactive TTY to accept the instance's SSH host key - the exact thing that stopped the previous run (`Host key verification failed`, recorded at SUMMARY.md:50). The throwaway repositories from that run were deleted, so no artifact remains to inspect, and the creation/visibility/origin half rests on the orchestrator's observation with no transcript in .planning/phases/1/reports/. Everything a stub CAN prove about this path is already proven (item 6).
